answers.answer: To connect the player: open the OBS page, choose Overlays in OBS and find Music Player. Choose Connect, then Copy address, and paste the address into a Browser source in OBS. Size the source 1 by 1 pixel, keep Control audio via OBS on, leave Shutdown source when not visible off, and check for Loaded in OBS. For YouTube, turn on Allow YouTube songs in Request rules, Sources tab, and choose Save. To control what plays, use Play, Pause and Next song in the Now playing panel, or pin player buttons with Add button.
answers.quote: In the dashboard, open the OBS page, choose Overlays in OBS, and find Music Player under Required overlays.

answers.answer: You need a signed-in dashboard role of Moderator or higher to use the controls, and OBS with a Browser source for YouTube. For Spotify you need a connected account with streaming permission and Premium. These are stated in Get your first song playing and Who can use this page.
answers.quote: Connect Spotify if you want to use it; the Music Player device needs Spotify Premium and a connection with streaming permission.

answers.answer: The Connect dialog status line shows Loaded in OBS once the player is connected. A playing song then appears in Now playing, and sound shows in the OBS audio mixer.
answers.quote: Loaded in OBS confirms the player connected.

answers.answer: The current track is in the Now playing panel, which shows the cover, the song name, the artist and the requester. Queued requests are in the Request queue panel. A YouTube request still waiting for the player shows Waiting for the Music Player in OBS there.
answers.quote: The song that plays now, its controls and the player buttons.

answers.answer: Selecting the Music Player as a Spotify device is introduced before the reader learns that it only appears after a Spotify song plays, so a first-time Spotify user may look for it in the list too early. It costs a reread of the Pick the Spotify device section.
answers.quote: Until a Spotify song plays, the device is not in the list.

answers.answer: The 12-button limit is stated twice in the same section, and the Stream Deck plugin comparison means nothing to a reader without that plugin. Read aloud, both add length without helping the task.
answers.quote: They use the same actions as the Stream Deck music plugin, and you can keep up to 12 in the channel.
